review_mode: Independent read-only exact source and transitive definitions; no builds or edits
findings: call is the actual TransactionEventBounds.message at the factory address, converted to a MessageCall.Context with inner fuel c.fuel-1 and exact runtime code. message binds checkpoint/original checkpoint, actual entrySubstate, sender/origin, entryGas/effectivePrice, transaction value/data, depth0 and permissiontrue.

checkpoint_factory rewrites the admitted literal upfront debit/nonce insertion, then uses distinct sender/factory to preserve the exact existing factory account. selected_code applies actual toExecute to that checkpoint, using non-precompile factory identity and installed bytes.

call_funding derives post-upfront value funding and worldFunds nonincrease from checkpoint_funded and exact checkpoint_debit. call_world_bound transports the explicit pre-world ceiling; no independent desired checkpoint balance is assumed.

call_result requires positive outer Theta fuel so truncated c.fuel-1 reconstructs c.fuel exactly. Its equality is of complete Except results, including failures/errors, and resolves actual checkpoint toExecute using hc.

provisional_of_call also requires the transaction recipient equal the factory address. It rewrites that same complete Theta result into the actual provisional branch and projects world/gas/substate/success without restricting success to true or changing the returned tuple.
assumptions_and_limits: TransactionFunding.Admission is the existing numeric/account admission structure, not full canonical signature/type/fork validation. Reference admission extraction remains open.

Installed factory, sender distinct from factory and positive fuel are explicit where needed. A hypothetical call to the factory is not selected by the transaction until ht is supplied in provisional_of_call.
No initializer success, canonical creation-address equation, post-transaction invariant, finalization/cleanup, or actual reference evaluator equivalence is established here.
